version: LOCK 68 V1 (9 Nov 2026) - the scholar's notebook, chapter 5: Neighbours and community
builds_on: LOCK 3 (page 1, read with Idris), LOCK 34 runner, LOCK 51 (the last page). Every reference checked on sunnah.com; the game never shows the reference.

words.find_kicker: The scholar's notebook · a page found
words.find_title: A page in the scholar's hand
words.read_button: Read the scholar's page with Idris
words.story: Idris turns back through the pages. “{t}”

chapter.title: Neighbours and community
chapter.story: In every town he stayed, he swept the masjid and asked the oldest neighbour for her stories.

pages.saying: Righteousness is good character, and sin is what wavers in your heart and you would hate people to find out.
pages.idris: If you'd hide it from Rashid, you already know what it is.
pages.found: Zaynab found a page lining an old hat bought from a pedlar.

pages.saying: Hold fast to my way and the way of the rightly guided after me; beware of newly invented matters.
pages.idris: The old road is safer than a short cut nobody has walked.
pages.found: Kamil hands you a loaf wrapped in an old page. “Look at the writing on this.”

pages.saying: A man asked for a deed to take him to Paradise; he was told the pillars, then the gates of good - fasting, charity, night prayer - and finally to guard his tongue.
pages.idris: Of all of it, the tongue was left for last. Think about why.
pages.found: Shakir found a folded page in a crack while mending a wall. “It's in a scholar's hand. You'll know who wants it.”

pages.saying: Allah has set duties - do not neglect them; limits - do not cross them; and He was silent about some things out of mercy, not forgetfulness - do not dig into them.
pages.idris: Not every question needs answering. Some silence is a mercy.
pages.found: Children are flying a kite made from an old page. Zaynab buys it from them for a date and gives it to you.

pages.saying: Detach yourself from the world and Allah will love you; detach yourself from what people own and people will love you.
pages.idris: Want less of what Jalal has. You'll sleep better than Jalal.
pages.found: Kamil found a page pressed inside a second-hand book.

pages.saying: There should be no harm, and no harming in return.
pages.idris: Four words in Arabic. A whole court of law in them.
pages.found: Shakir has been using a page to wrap spices and has only just noticed the writing.

pages.saying: If people were given whatever they claimed, they would claim others' wealth and blood; the claimant must bring proof, and the one who denies takes an oath.
pages.idris: Khattab shouted. Proof is what settled it.
pages.found: Zaynab pulls a damp page from the bottom of a basket and dries it for you.

pages.saying: Whoever sees a wrong, let him change it with his hand; if he cannot, with his tongue; if he cannot, with his heart - and that is the weakest of faith.
pages.idris: Hamid's toll. You had all three choices that day.
pages.found: Kamil found a page under a loose floor tile.

pages.saying: Do not envy, cheat, hate or turn your backs on each other; be brothers. A Muslim does not wrong, abandon or despise his brother. Allah looks at your hearts and deeds.
pages.idris: The heart, again. He keeps coming back to the heart.
pages.found: Shakir was given a debt note - and the scholar's page is written on the back of it.

pages.saying: Whoever removes a hardship from a believer, Allah removes one of his hardships on the Day of Resurrection; whoever covers a Muslim's fault, Allah covers his; whoever takes a path to knowledge, Allah eases his path to Paradise.
pages.idris: Rahma's ward. Kamil's term. All of it in one page.
pages.found: Zaynab's little one folded a page into a paper boat. Zaynab dried it out for you.
